# GitHub Trending Rank Radar

> Independent open-source GitHub trending radar. Tracks ~1,300 repositories with twice-daily snapshots (UTC 02:00 & 14:00) and computes eight leaderboards: new repos (<90 days), daily / weekly / monthly star growth, daily / weekly / monthly growth rate, and an all-time chart. Browsable by day, month and year. Bilingual UI (中文 / English). Live at https://zhuikan.com/

## What this site is

- Live leaderboard: https://zhuikan.com/
- Source code & raw data: https://github.com/awesome-market/trending-rank-radar
- License: Apache-2.0 (code and data)
- No tracking, no accounts, no ads — pure static site, data served as JSON files

## Machine-readable open data

All ranking data is precomputed and served as static JSON — free to reuse (Apache-2.0):

- `data/index.json` — index: repo count, snapshot_days, available `dates`, `months`, `years`, `latest_day`, `site_base`
- `data/days/YYYY-MM-DD.json` — one file per calendar day (Beijing time), containing all boards
- `data/months/YYYY-MM.json` — month view: month boards + cumulative + daily Top-10 grid
- `data/years/YYYY.json` — year view: per-month growth cards
- `data/repos/<owner>__<name>.json` — per-repo detail: metrics, day/week/month growth, full star history (dates/stars/forks/watchers), board placements, top issues, latest discussions, latest release, README excerpt
- Repo detail pages: `https://zhuikan.com/repo.html?r=<owner>/<name>`
- Full snapshots: `data/snapshots/YYYY-MM-DDTHH.json` in the GitHub repo (raw per-repo counters)

## Boards (in each day/month file, under `boards.<name>.items`)

- `new` — repos created within 90 days, ranked by current stars
- `daily` / `weekly` / `monthly` — absolute star growth over the window (fallback: earliest available snapshot, actual range annotated)
- `daily_rate` / `weekly_rate` / `monthly_rate` — growth ÷ base stars at window start (base ≥ 50 required)
- `total` — all-time stars
- `cumulative` — (month files only) this month's cumulative growth

Per-item fields: `full_name`, `owner`, `stars`, `forks`, `watchers`, `issues`, `prs`, `releases`, `language`, `created_at`, `incr`, `rate`, `stars_begin`, `window`, `approx`, `series` (30-point star sparkline), `rank`/`prev_rank`.

## Methodology

- Collection: GitHub Trending + Search + GraphQL API, self-hosted watchlist (~1,300 repos, rolling)
- Snapshots twice daily at UTC 02:00 / 14:00; days bucketed by Beijing date, last snapshot of a day is canonical
- Rankings are computed from snapshot deltas within the tracked set — not a mirror of GitHub's own trending page
- Extended metrics (watchers / issues / PRs / releases) refresh once daily and are carried forward between refreshes
